items.title: Belgian viranomaiset keskeyttivät Googlen datakeskuksen rakentamisen
items.summary: Belgian viranomaiset ovat määränneet Googlen keskeyttämään datakeskuksen rakentamisen maan eteläosassa, koska hankkeella ei ole asianmukaista rakennuslupaa. Aluehallinnon edustaja kertoi asiasta perjantaina. – Olemme havainneet vakavan rikkomuksen: kolmen hehtaarin kokoista rakennusta rakennetaan luvatta, Vallonian aluehallinnon tiedottaja Nicolas Yernaux kertoi perjantaina. Belgialainen hollanninkielinen yleisradioyhtiö VRT kertoi toissapäivänä, että Google jatkaa datakeskuksen rakentamista Farciennesissa, vaikka sillä ei ole ollut rakennuslupaa kesän jälkeen.

items.title: Threat Hunting Using Memory Leaks in Banner Grabs
items.summary: In October, I was analysing some of our banner grabs in Target Intelligence and noticed a weird string in some STUN data that looked suspiciously like a memory address. Further digging into this, using vendor fingerprinting techniques, some reverse engineering and a local lab setup, I was able to show this was a previously unknown vulnerability in coturn 4.10.0, which VulnCheck subsequently assigned CVE-2026-104074. Using the shape of the leaked bytes, I was also able to tell apart most hosts running the official Debian image, the official Alpine image and Alpine's own coturn package.

items.title: Four Requests to Shell: Ek0ms's Cacti 0-Day Chain
items.summary: Four HTTP requests. A guest session. A shell command delivered through a graphing system's own poller. Ek0ms, publishing with Church of Malware, documented this Cacti chain as 4HTTP2ROOT. A working unauth-RCE against Cacti Core 1.2.31. Her research follows a value from a guest-editable profile setting into a SQL LIMIT clause, then uses the resulting database write to change the command that Cacti's realtime poller executes. The upstream research and PoC are hers; this article summarizes the path and its operating conditions.

items.title: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC gives remote code execution
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in the Cacti network monitoring platform has been publicly disclosed, along with a proof-of-concept exploit that lets unauthenticated attackers execute commands on vulnerable servers. The exploit, dubbed "4HTTP2SHELL" (previously 4HTTP2ROOT), was published on Thanksgiving Day by a cybersecurity researcher known as ek0ms savi0r from the Church of Malware, who demonstrated how the vulnerability can be exploited using just four HTTP requests. Cacti is an open-source network monitoring and graphing tool used to monitor the performance of servers, routers, switches, firewalls, and other network infrastructure. Because the software can store credentials and SNMP passphrases used to access or read data from monitored devices, compromising a Cacti server could potentially give attackers access to other systems on a corporate network.

items.title: Software giant SAP confirms cyber incident amid reports of source code breach
items.summary: German software giant SAP confirmed a cybersecurity incident following reports that hackers infiltrated its software development infrastructure, potentially gaining access to the company’s source code. In a statement to Recorded Future News on Friday, SAP said it had identified suspicious activity and immediately taken steps to protect its customers and secure its services. The company did not disclose the nature or extent of the intrusion. “Based on our investigation to date, we have found no evidence of unauthorized access to customer business data,” SAP said. “We will continue to strengthen our security to provide the secure and resilient environment our customers depend on.”

items.title: Drupal sites are being hijacked, and a follow-up flaw is already under attack
items.summary: Attackers are exploiting a second critical flaw in Drupal, the content management system (CMS) behind many government, university, corporate, and media websites. Site owners are responsible for applying the fix. For visitors, a hijacked site can put personal data and devices at risk. On November 18, Drupal released a patch for a remote code execution (RCE) flaw, CVE-2026-132165. The flaw could let attackers take over a site by abusing Drupal’s installer file, install.php. Drupal’s security team received a report of attacks on live sites as early as November 19. On November 25, Drupal released a second advisory for CVE-2026-136716. Some sites in “unusual or incomplete install states” remained vulnerable to takeover after the first fix, including live sites. Drupal says the new flaw is also being exploited in the wild.

items.title: British social security system techies yank services offline following 'cyber incident'
items.summary: The UK's Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) has taken some services offline after detecting a "cyber incident," but says regular benefit and pension payments are unaffected. The department announced the precautionary shutdown on Friday morning. "We have taken some DWP online services offline as a precaution after we identified a cyber incident affecting our systems," it said. "We are working closely with the National Cyber Security Centre and Government Cyber Coordination Centre (GC3) to investigate and to bring services back online as quickly as possible and to minimize any disruption. "Regular benefit and pension payments are not affected and will be paid as normal. If an online service you need is unavailable, please try again later. As always, we will never message you to ask for bank details or ask you to click on links."

items.title: US Air Force cloud platform reportedly hacked in latest federal breach
items.summary: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, adding to a recent wave of cyberattacks affecting US government agencies, including the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department. According to Reuters, the intrusion was discovered within the past month during an upgrade of the cloud platform, disrupting application migrations and software updates. Launched in 2017, Cloud One is an enterprise cloud computing platform managed by the US Air Force that allows Department of Defense agencies to host and manage applications supporting military operations, personnel management, logistics, and maintenance. According to one source who spoke to Reuters, the hackers exploited an unidentified software vulnerability to gain access to the platform, potentially exposing sensitive military operational and logistics information. US Cyber Command has reportedly been called in to assess the impact, with the attackers, scope of the attack, and whether any data was stolen currently unknown.

items.title: Cyberattack disrupts global news distribution platform at France’s AFP
items.summary: French international news agency Agence France-Presse (AFP) was hit by a cyberattack Thursday, forcing it to take offline one of its main platforms for distributing news content to media organizations worldwide. The attack targeted AFP Forum, an online platform that news outlets use to browse and download the agency’s stories, photographs and videos. AFP confirmed the incident Thursday in an internal email to employees, which was quoted in the agency’s own reporting. The agency is investigating the attack with assistance from external cybersecurity experts. “AFP was hit by a cyber attack overnight. The target was AFP Forum, one of the platforms our clients use to browse and download our content,” AFP management said in the email. “As soon as the intrusion was detected, our teams moved immediately to contain the intrusion and took AFP Forum offline as a precautionary measure. AFP Forum remains unavailable until further notice.”

items.title: Turun kaupungin käyttämään järjestelmään kohdistunut kyberhyökkäys
items.summary: Turun kaupungin käyttämään Vitec Hotellinx -järjestelmään on kohdistunut kyberhyökkäys, tiedottaa kaupunki. Järjestelmää käyttävät Turun ammatti-instituutin laivahostel S/S Bore ja opetusravintola Taito. Hyökkääjä on voinut päästä käsiksi osaan asiakastiedoista, kuten nimi, sähköpostiosoite ja varausnumero. Asiaa selvitetään yhteistyössä järjestelmätoimittajan kanssa.
